contexts.text: This good by its translucence confers resplendence.
The work of a sapphire = what is translucid (in the sense of the letter) from internal truths... thus when the Divine truth... shines through it.
In order to present some idea of this translucence (of the sense of the letter)...
These senses shine through the literal sense.
The sense of the letter was not then attended to except in so far as the wisdom hidden in it shone through from it.
A precious stone = the truth which is translucent from the Divine.
Divine truths translucent in the ultimate of order. Signified.
Truth which is translucent from internal truths. Signified.
The reason all things of the Word are translucent from the Lord. Explained.
The translucence of the angelic Heaven. Signified, Explained.
The reason the Word is translucent with these. Explained. TCR 231:2.
That all the Divine truth of the Word in the sense of the letter with the men of this Church is translucent from the Divine truth in the spiritual sense. Signified, Explained.
Its translucence in Divine truth natural.
